strings.meta.title: pdff — Ka bomu, sesa ne nsakrae PDF, Word, Excel a ɛnyɛ hwee
strings.meta.description: Nnoɔma a ɛwɔ intanɛt so a ɛnyɛ hwee a wubetumi de abom, asesa, asinasin, atwitwa ne ahobanbɔ ama wo PDF, Word, Excel, PowerPoint ne mfonini nkrataa. Ɛnsɛ sɛ wutwerɛ wo din, yiyi wo nkrataa ko ntɛm ara.

strings.seo.whyTitle: Adɛn nti na ɛsɛ sɛ wofa pdff?
strings.seo.why[0].title: 100% ɛnyɛ hwee
strings.seo.why[0].text: Sika a wotua biara nni hɔ, kɔɔto ka biara nni hɔ, nsɛnkyerɛnne biara nni hɔ a wɔaka akyekyɛ wo nkrataa ho.
strings.seo.why[1].title: Ɛnsɛ sɛ wutwerɛ wo din
strings.seo.why[1].text: Aka konto biara nni hɔ a wobɛbɔ: bue krataa no, gu wo nkrataa, na awie.
strings.seo.why[2].title: Wo nkrataa yɛ wo de
strings.seo.why[2].text: Wɔyɛ ho adwuma, na woyi fi hɔ ntɛm ara. Yɛnkora wo nkrataa anaa wo nsɛm so.
strings.seo.why[3].title: Kwan biara
strings.seo.why[3].text: PDF, Word, Excel, PowerPoint, OpenDocument, mfonini, EPUB... fi kɔmputa so anaasɛ fon so.
strings.seo.faqTitle: Nsɛm a nnipa bisa taa ba
strings.seo.faq[0].q: Ɛyɛ nokorɛ sɛ pdff nyɛ hwee?
strings.seo.faq[0].a: Aane. Adwuma biara nyɛ hwee, nsɛnkyerɛnne nni ho na biribiara nni hɔ a wɔaka akyekyɛ akyi. Wɔnsrɛ kɔɔto ka da.
strings.seo.faq[1].a: Dabi. Ɛnsɛ sɛ wutwerɛ wo din, email nni hɔ: wodi dwuma wɔ nnoɔma no ho ntɛm ara.
strings.seo.faq[2].a: Dabi. Wɔde wo nkrataa di dwuma pɔtee a wubisa no nko ara, na afei woyi fi hɔ. Obi nkenkan na wɔntɔn bi da.
strings.seo.faq[3].a: Aane. pdff yɛ adwuma wɔ fon biara, tabilase anaa kɔmputa (Android, iPhone, Windows, Mac, Linux) so, biribiara nni hɔ a ɛsɛ sɛ wutintim.
strings.seo.faq[4].a: PDF, Word (DOCX, DOC), Excel (XLSX, XLS, CSV), PowerPoint (PPTX, PPT), OpenDocument (ODT, ODS, ODP), RTF, mfonini (JPG, PNG, WebP, AVIF, TIFF, GIF, SVG), EPUB, TXT, HTML ne nea ɛkeka ho.
strings.seo.faq[5].a: Wubetumi ayɛ nkrataa kosi {files} wɔ bere koro pɛ mu, na krataa a wɔayi abɔ mu betumi wɔ nkrataa kosi {pages}.
strings.privacy.title: Asɛm a ɛfa kokoam ho
strings.privacy.description: Sɛnea pdff hwɛ wo nkrataa so: konto biara nni hɔ, krataa biara nni hɔ a wɔkora so, adwamen nni hɔ na wɔntɔn nsɛm biara.
strings.privacy.intro: Wɔakyekyɛ pdff ama wo nkrataa aka wo de. Ha ne nsɛm a ɛte, wɔ nsɛm tiawa mu, nea ɛba bere a wodi dwuma.
strings.privacy.sections[0].title: Wo nkrataa
strings.privacy.sections[0].text: Wɔde kɔ (HTTPS) a wɔaka ho ban, wodi ho adwuma, na woyi fi hɔ ntɛm ara sɛ nea efi mu aba no asiesie ho. Nkrataa kɛse kɔ baabi a ɛtwɛn bere tiawa kɔto din a wɔde ato hɔ na woyi fi hɔ ntɛm ara bere a adwuma no wie; ohwie kwan a ɛyɛ ne ho adwuma yi biribiara a ebetumi aka wɔ nnɔnhwerew 24 mu.
strings.privacy.sections[1].title: Konto biara nni hɔ, nsɛm pɔtee biara nni hɔ
strings.privacy.sections[1].text: pdff nsɛm biara nni hɔ a ɛbisa krataa twerɛ, email anaa kɔɔto ka. Wɔnkenkan wo nkrataa da, wɔnhwehwɛ mu, wɔntɔn anaasɛ wɔde yɛ adwuma sɛnea wɔbɛtete nyansa a ɛyɛ adwuma.
strings.privacy.sections[2].title: Nnipa dodow a wɔba
strings.privacy.sections[2].text: Yɛkan nnipa a wɔba a yɛnni wɔn ho nim ne cookies nni hɔ (Vercel Web Analytics) na yɛhu nnoɔma a ɛwɔ mfaso. Adwamen nni hɔ, nnipa a wɔdi akyi nni hɔ.
strings.privacy.sections[3].title: Cookies
strings.privacy.sections[3].text: Cookie baako pɛ, a ɛnyɛ bɔne: ɛkae kasa a wopaw no.
strings.privacy.sections[4].title: Sɛnea wɔhwɛ so
strings.privacy.sections[4].text: Vercel na ɛhwɛ sɔte no so wɔ Paris; Word, Excel ne PowerPoint nsesae no kɔ Render nsam wɔ Frankfurt. Nkrataa ahwɛfo yi di nkrataa ho dwuma wɔ nsesae bere no nko ara.
strings.privacy.sections[5].title: Fa wo ho to yɛn so
strings.privacy.sections[5].text: Asɛm anaa adwene? Ka kyerɛ yɛn fi adwuma no krataa so:
strings.tools.fusionner.name: Bom
strings.tools.fusionner.tagline: Fa nkrataa pii (PDF, Word, mfonini...) bom yɛ no PDF baako, wɔ nhyehyɛe a wopaw mu.
strings.tools.fusionner.seoTitle: Bom PDF nkrataa wɔ intanɛt so a ɛnyɛ hwee (Word, mfonini, PDF)
strings.tools.fusionner.seoDescription: Fa PDF, Word, Excel, PowerPoint ne mfonini nkrataa bom yɛ no PDF baako, wɔ nhyehyɛe a wopaw mu. Ɛnyɛ hwee, ɛnsɛ sɛ wutwerɛ wo din, nsɛnkyerɛnne nni hɔ, woyi nkrataa fi hɔ ntɛm ara.
strings.tools.fusionner.intro: Fa wo nkrataa nyinaa bom yɛ no krataa baako: pdff gye PDF nanso egye nso Word nkrataa, Excel nkrataa, nkyerɛkyerɛmu ne mfonini, na ɛbom yɛ no PDF pa baako a krataa biara wɔ akyerɛwde.

strings.tools.extraire.intro: Krataa a nni hɔ, asɛm a ɛho nni mfaso, nea ɛsan ba? Twerɛ nkrataa a wobɛkora anaa wobɛyi fi hɔ (nhwɛso sɛ 1-3, 7, 10-end) na nya PDF pa sesɛkɛnd kakraa bi mu.
